name: Grand Blue [Early Access]
desc:
We are in ✨EARLY ACCESS✨, expect bugs/lag as we work to improve the game.

Embark on an epic pirate adventure across the world of Grand Blue! Master powerful fighting styles, discover cursed fruits with incredible abilities, and grow stronger with every battle. Defeat challenging bosses, collect and craft rare weapons and equipment, and explore unique islands. Challenge rivals and forge your legend to become the strongest!

Info:
Cursed Fruits spawn every hour on trees and plants. There are multiple ways to obtain Cursed Fruits, so search for them all!
Cursed Fruit skill levels save for each fruit, don't worry about swapping off!
The Logbook contains a lot of information about the world, be sure to check it.

❗Exploiting will ban you, do not exploit you will be caught❗
